name: Fractal
description:
About This Game

Fractal is a puzzle adventure game, inspired by Valve's Portal series. It tells a story, about a mountain climber, stuck in the long forgotten facility, now trying to find his way out.

"Once a root of inovation, now an abandoned facility, hidden away by time and rumble. Fractal tells a compelling story of the rise and eventual fall of the Prismatica Technologies, one of the pioneers in scientific acheivements. With mind altering puzzles, you will have to plan all your steps through this technological journey to discover what really happened inside these walls and find a way out of your confinement."

Main Features:

  • Full single-player campaign.

  • Laser gun mechanic. This gun will allow you to create lasers which will stay mid-air.

  • A lot of interesting test chambers, playing around the concept of laser reflections, colors and physics.

  • Custom soundtrack.

  • Beautiful environment done in 1990 retro style with every texture being made in pixel-art style by hand.

  • Intriguing story, revolving around themes of loneliness and legacy of a company, the golden age of which faded a long time ago.
short_desc: Fractal is a puzzle adventure game, inspired by Valve's Portal series, featuring puzzles centered around lasers, colors and reflections, telling a story about legacy and loneliness, done in a unique pixel-art artstyle.
